docs.summary: Hand written C# lexer for instant highlighting with no compiler behind it. Handles every literal form (verbatim, interpolated, raw and multi line), doc comments, preprocessor lines and contextual keywords.
docs.remarks: State layout: low byte is the mode, bits 8 to 15 the raw string quote count, bits 16 to 23 the interpolation dollar count. Mode 0 is plain code.

members.name: Tokenize
members.signature: public int Tokenize(string line, int state, List<CodeToken>? tokens)
